scope: review of the pre-registered two-class protocol/label spec, the T31 annotation schema, the installed pose loss mask, the inference GT boundary, the v4.1 unlabeled-MS1 risk and the two-class evaluation denominators; T30 capture is still in progress and no v6 two-class labels exist yet

two_class_eval_baseline.note: evaltool's same-caliber single-class baseline; two-class model numbers PENDING

positives_already_satisfied: protocol explicitly forbids mapping class1 to the central-tower landmark_id and states class1 is NOT an open-set catch-all
protocol/spec define class1 keypoint as unavailable (v=0) and forbid bbox-centre substitution
same-frame rule: every visible/decidable instance of both classes must be labelled; MS1 must not be left as background
label spec requires QA with fail-loud for instance counts, same-frame counts, v distribution and keypoint mask
T31 schema makes the coordinate domains explicit (bbox source-pixel XYXY, keypoint normalized [0,1]) and aligns GT_UNOBSERVABLE with the protocol (present+FULL occlusion+no class0 instance)
loss mask audit PASS: class1 v=0 contributes exactly 0 to the keypoint coordinate loss, class0 v=1 is supervised, visibility is supervised to 0 for class1
GT isolation audit: model.predict is image-only and decoder uses predicted class/score/bbox/keypoint only; one API coupling finding remains (R1)

findings.finding: the frozen label spec defines class1 as the verified map-native MS1, but the T31 schema allows verified_source=EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE (synthetic injection) for class1. A synthetic HN1 confuser and the map-native MS1 would then share one class, diluting 'verified MS1' into 'any similar structure' — the protocol explicitly says class1 is not an open-set/catch-all class.
findings.required_resolution: restrict class1 to map-native MS1 only (verified_source=WORLD_POSE_OR_MAP_DB + map-DB record); put synthetic HN1 and any other similar structure into other_structures[]/confusers and evaluate them as a separate false-claim stratum. If the team wants one merged 'similar structure' class, version the label spec (v1.1) and state the semantic change before labelling.
findings.default_conservative: class1=map-native MS1 only; synthetic injections are never class1

findings.finding: neither the label spec nor the T31 schema defines how to record visible unverified green/tower-like structures (MS2 symmetric candidate, unknown green lamps, robots/gantry, synthetic confusers). Leaving them unlabelled makes them background for training and invisible in the class1 denominator, but the two-class model may still emit them as class0/class1, which must count as a false identity claim.
findings.required_resolution: add an explicit other_structures[] (or confusers[]) record with verified=false per visible unverified structure; never assign class1; add an evaluation stratum 'unverified/other structure frames' whose tower claims are counted as false claims and reported separately (not part of the MS1 denominator).
findings.default_conservative: record, do not train as class1; evaluate false claims separately

findings.finding: the same-frame completeness rule is machine-checkable only if labels are cross-checked against an independent visibility source; a label-only QA cannot prove that no MS1 instance was missed. The v4.1 projection method in this review shows a cheap, reproducible check.
findings.required_resolution: add a projection/pose completeness gate to the v6 label QA: for every frame, project the central tower and MS1 from the recorded SW camera pose; if projected MS1 height >= 8 px then require a class1 instance OR gt_uncertainty=INSTANCE_UNRESOLVED (reason recorded); likewise for the tower; otherwise the label batch FAILs. Reuse scripts/v41_ms1_risk.py (calibrated to 0.04 px median).
findings.default_conservative: label gate FAIL on any unmatched projected instance

findings.finding: no minimum visible size or occlusion rule for class1. Far MS1 (projected height <8 px) may be present but not decidable; guessing a bbox would inject noise and violate the 'decidable instance' rule.
findings.required_resolution: define decidable class1 as projected bbox height >= 8 px (conservative: >= 10 px) without full occlusion; below that record gt_uncertainty=INSTANCE_UNRESOLVED with reason and no instance. Apply the same rule consistently to class0 and keep TINY in all-domain/reported separately.
findings.default_conservative: 8 px height; no instance below that

findings.finding: identity_ambiguity (NONE|UNCERTAIN|AMBIGUOUS) and gt_uncertainty (NONE|FULLY_OCCLUDED|REFERENCE_UNRESOLVED|INSTANCE_UNRESOLVED) are proposed in T31 but are not part of the frozen label spec v1; handling rules for these states in training/evaluation are not pre-registered in the spec.
findings.required_resolution: freeze the enums and their handling as a versioned addendum (spec v1.1 or protocol addendum) BEFORE labelling: ambiguous/uncertain frames excluded from class training or reported separately; GT_UNCERTAIN not scored as localization; improper tower claims on them listed separately.
findings.default_conservative: freeze as v1.1 addendum with explicit handling

findings.finding: class1 keypoint must never be a real reference, but YOLO pose labels still carry x,y per keypoint. The builder must write 0,0,v=0 (never bbox centre); the loader/dataloader preserves v and the loss masks v=0, so a bbox-centre placeholder would not change the loss but would be a latent trap for any downstream reader.
findings.required_resolution: label builder writes keypoint_x=keypoint_y=0.0 and v=0 for class1; QA asserts class1 keypoint values are exactly 0 (or null at the annotation layer) and never equal the bbox centre; round-trip test through the ultralytics loader.

findings.finding: ultralytics 8.2.0 verify_image_label preserves the written v and only enforces coords in [0,1] and non-negative values; v=2 (or any non-zero) is treated as visible by the loss mask (demonstrated in the mask audit). A typo v=2 on class1 would silently reintroduce keypoint supervision.
findings.required_resolution: label builder and QA must fail loud unless v in {0,1}; add a test feeding v=2 and expecting rejection.

findings.finding: the spec lists verified_source as an instance field but does not require it for class1. Without a required world/map verification source, class1 could be assigned by appearance alone.
findings.required_resolution: require verified_source=WORLD_POSE_OR_MAP_DB for class1 and a cross-link to the map-DB record (map_native_structures.json); class1 instances lacking it FAIL QA.

findings.finding: T31 QA checks duplicate same-class boxes but not class0/class1 overlap. One object labelled as both classes would corrupt both the class and identity confusion matrix.
findings.required_resolution: add QA rule: class0 vs class1 bbox IoU must be below a small threshold (e.g., 0.3) unless an explicit ambiguity record exists.

findings.finding: the protocol requires partially occluded decidable instances to be labelled with the visible part + occluded flag; the T31 truncation QA requires true edges to touch the image border, which is the right rule for truncation but must not be applied to occlusion clipping.
findings.required_resolution: separate truncation (image-edge) from occlusion (object clipping); record both fields; QA must not require touch-edge for occluded boxes.

findings.finding: T31 representation (tower_present=true + occlusion=FULL + no class0 instance) matches the protocol and the previous GT_UNOBSERVABLE convention; the loader must write an empty training label (not a negative) and the evaluator must single-list it.
findings.required_resolution: add a loader/evaluator test for the FULL-occlusion frame: empty YOLO label, GT_UNOBSERVABLE bucket, no negative denominator.

findings.finding: T31 fixes bbox=source-pixel XYXY and keypoint=normalized [0,1]; the YOLO txt requires source-normalized bbox and keypoint. Mixing domains was the root cause of the 2026-11-04 label bug.
findings.required_resolution: loader converts bbox /W,/H and writes the normalized keypoint directly; add a round-trip test (labels -> txt -> ultralytics loader -> pixel coords) with <=0.001 px error and an explicit coordinate_space field.
findings.default_conservative: keep the two domains explicit and tested

evaluation_denominators_and_certificatio.tower_class: val_main observable tower positives 95 (protocol) + val_main negatives; two-class confusion matrix per class; val_main MS1 additional labels are still PENDING (T32)

identity.precision_denominator: class0 claims (tower claims, after conflict/margin rejection)
identity.recall_denominator: 44 observable tower instances in the 62-frame development identity pool
identity.false_match_denominator: negatives incl. 9 MS1-only frames + other negatives; MS1 false tower claims reported on the 9-frame and 35-object denominators separately
identity.gt_unobservable: 9 frames kept in all-domain, single-listed; improper claims counted, not scored as negative
identity.gt_uncertain: 0 in the current identity pool; must be single-listed when present

reference.n_avail: 18 tower-reference-available frames in the identity pool; val_main 41 available / 122 unavailable (v4 163-frame label document)

consumer.policy: UNKNOWN/REJECTED stay in the applicable success denominator; no deletion of hard frames; TINY kept in all-domain and reported separately

certification_boundary: two-class solves only 'central tower vs verified map-native MS1' inside the current bounded asset domain; it is NOT open-set identity recognition
class1 must never be mapped to the central-tower landmark_id; class conflict/multiple candidates/low confidence/unavailable reference must be explicit UNKNOWN/REJECTED
no certification from development data: a passing development gate only allows a new untouched holdout (v3) capture; the holdout is process-isolated same-agent data, not third-party sealed truth
no board/RKNN/real-camera/real-arena claim; latency and thermal behaviour remain UNKNOWN
T25/T26 provisional diagnostic frames are excluded from every denominator; old packages/models/protocols stay closed and unchanged
single-class v2 baseline class1 recall=0 is structural (no class1 channel) and is a reference point, not a performance regression
automatic identity restoration is not claimed: two-class identity precision must pass its own gate, and class0 claims remain conditional on score/conflict/appearance/reference rules

acceptance_checklist_before_labelling_or: lead ruling on S1/S2 class1 scope + other structures
freeze S5 enums/handling as spec v1.1 or protocol addendum
S3 projection-based same-frame completeness gate wired into the v6 QA and run on the v6 labels
S4 minimum/maximum decidability rule and S8 verified_source requirement in the QA
S6/S7/S12 builder/loader round-trip tests (0,0,v=0; v in {0,1}; coordinate domains)
GT isolation finding R1 refactored/tested before P2 smoke sign-off
v4.1 risk decision: exclude the affected frames or annotate class1 (pre-registered before training)
denominators above frozen in the evaluation protocol and used unchanged by the two-class model run
